prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Create ONE neutral approval-preview bust portrait of the "Herdeiro Nórdico", a new adult male heir for an existing medieval narrative RPG.

Input roles: the FIRST supplied image, the mature northern warrior with swept-back long hair, shaved temples, large mustache, braided beard and fur shoulders, defines this NEW character's identity and clothing inspiration. The OTHER THREE supplied images (the existing braided female heir, crowned coin-holder and tired crowned heir) define the REQUIRED simplified drawing style, bust proportions, linework and exact warm-white palette. Do not copy their faces, crowns or expressions.

Translate the first warrior into the existing heir cast's subtly caricatured medieval ink style. Preserve his recognizable strong brow, angular broad nose, mature square face, swept-back shoulder-length hair with a closely shaven temple and one side braid, thick long mustache and long beard divided into two readable broad braids. A small plain ring earring and small braid bands may use restrained aged gold. Suggest the temple marking/scar with just a few simple dark ink strokes instead of realistic skin texture or a complex tattoo. Keep him a robust mature adult, not an exaggerated bodybuilder, monster or generic old wizard. His eyes are simple dark ink shapes beneath stern brows, with a composed firm closed-mouth expression rather than an aggressive snarl.

Costume is a modest neutral northern outfit: plain tunic with a simple split neckline, narrow leather shoulder fastenings and a small dark fur collar that lies close to the shoulders. Fur is described with a few broad clumps and economical hatch marks. No elaborate armor, weapon, helmet, crown, jewelry overload or huge fur mantle. This is the initial neutral state, leaving room for future honor variants.

Composition: centered bust only, head, neck, shoulders and upper chest, gentle three-quarter angle retaining the source's orientation. Large readable head in the same proportions as the existing heirs, all hair and both shoulders contained inside a square canvas with clean margins, softly curved bottom cutout. No hands or full body.

Style MUST be the same as the three existing heir portraits: thick irregular hand-drawn black contours, simplified expressive facial anatomy, broad flat warm-white areas, sparse hatching and subtle paper grain ONLY inside the figure. Skin, light hair and beard, and light cloth share their warm near-white approximately #F9EEDD, with black shadow shapes between the light strands. Do not use realistic skin tones, slate-blue hair, blue eyes, colored tunic or the darker yellow-beige event palette. Only tiny muted aged-gold accents.

Prefer 1024x1024; output ONE character cutout with genuinely fully transparent alpha. No background, parchment sheet, frame, circular halo, scenery, lettering, glow or shadow outside the silhouette. No anime/manga rendering from the source, photorealism, realistic pores, painterly shading, 3D, children's cartoon, dense engraving or fussy detail. He must look like another character drawn by the same artist as the existing heirs.
